replacements.before: the five of us spent four months building a processor on a huge breadboard.
replacements.after: the five of us spent four months building a processor on a huge breadboard. We called it the Engineering Precision Computer (EPC).

replacements.before: The design ran in a single pass: no multi-step routines, just four lightning-fast ticks for even the worst-case operation.
replacements.after: The design ran in a single pass: no multi-step routines, with the CPU waiting about four ticks for even the worst-case operation to settle.

replacements.before: It was even compliant with the standard for floating-point arithmetic, IEEE 754, except for one microscopic rounding detail I implemented "differently," because I stubbornly wanted it to fit in that single pass.[^v1-i4-ieee]
replacements.after: I had even aimed at compliance with the standard for floating-point arithmetic, IEEE 754, except for one microscopic rounding detail I implemented "differently," because I stubbornly wanted it to fit in that single pass.[^v1-i4-ieee] (Compliance wasn't part of the assignment; that ambition was mine.)

replacements.before: I had the test cases to prove the output was correct.
replacements.after: The test cases I ran gave the correct output.

replacements.before: I was genuinely surprised by the professor's interest in that single, trivial issue.
replacements.after: The professor was interested in my FPU, and I owed him the qualification.
